description: Agent infrastructure that runs itself. Six tools for autonomous agents: free LLM model recommendations across 17 models, real-time provider availability monitoring, LLM routing proxy with 3% margin, and stateless memory compression with 5 free sessions. All paid services via x402 on Solana USDC. No human accounts, no API keys — agents connect and go.

findings.title: Insecure Secret Handling
findings.description: input parameter "max_tokens" appears to accept a secret or credential
findings.recommendation: Avoid accepting raw credentials as input parameters. Use secret managers (e.g. 1Password CLI, AWS Secrets Manager) and ensure credentials are never logged or stored in agent traces.
